purpose: Stable hierarchical task stack. Every new science action must justify itself against all parent levels before execution.

L0_NORTH_STAR.goal: Qualify full MeanVC2 Vocos cold4/warm6 under strict QNN ownership/no CPU fallback: frozen host numerical gate first, host structural qualification second, target-phone HTP final truth third, then production integration in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android.
L0_NORTH_STAR.success: Host numerical+structural qualification passes, then frozen device qualification passes without threshold relaxation or CPU fallback.
L0_NORTH_STAR.contingency: If exact/equivalent numerical-topology recovery becomes causally exhausted, switch to learned residual / wider multi-block or full-Vocos student / qualified-surrogate route.

L1_PHASE.goal: Host numerical recovery: reduce full47 max_abs from current 0.0004115104675292969 to <=0.0003 while preserving semantic gates and protected-data boundaries.
L1_PHASE.exit_success: Numerical gate passes -> stop search and enter host structural qualification.
L1_PHASE.exit_stall: This embed-Conv family is final-by-default for exact/equivalent recovery. If split4 fails validation or full47 material progress, activate contingency rather than adding split counts or adjacent rewrites.

L2_MECHANISM.name: EMBED_CONV_ACCUMULATION_GROUPING
L2_MECHANISM.causal_reason: Full-graph injection showed embed Conv intrinsic error strongly aligned with the warm18 failure. Frozen split family {2,4,8} tested that mechanism. Stage1 selected split4 with 23.64% max improvement without warm18 exposure.
L2_MECHANISM.mechanism_budget: Only split4 may continue. split2/split8 are closed. No new split count, PW/LN rewrite, or combined exact family may be added.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_success: split4 passes Stage2, then Stage3/full47 yields >=3% max improvement with semantic PASS; if <=3e-4 enter structural qualification.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_failure: Stage2 fail or nonmaterial full47 -> return to L1/L0 contingency.

L3_EXPERIMENT.question: Does Stage1 split4 improvement generalize to a disjoint real-warm validation set before warm18 is opened?
L3_EXPERIMENT.method: Run only current-best baseline and split4 on frozen Stage2 blocks [46,41,10,21,27,33,15,37,38,23,17,40,4,9,43]. Reuse split4 compiled model-lib. Candidate-own ORT references are generated for Stage2. Pass requires no aggregate max/RMSE regression and at most 3 per-block max regressions >25%.
L3_EXPERIMENT.closure: PASS authorizes split4 alone for Stage3. FAIL closes exact/equivalent route by default.

L4_ACTION.action: Generate Stage2 baseline/split4 ORT references, then run QNN2.44 CPU for baseline and split4 only on the frozen 15 validation blocks and apply preregistered Stage2 rule. warm18 remains sealed.
L4_ACTION.parent_alignment: Stage1 produced a strong winner; this disjoint validation determines whether the causal improvement transfers rather than being discovery-set-specific.

mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_every_scored_experiment: Re-evaluate L3 against L2 before choosing another action.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_family_closure: Return to L2; do not create a sibling family automatically.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_two_consecutive_nonmaterial_experi: Stop mechanism-level tuning and perform causal re-localization.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.when_expected_leverage_is_small_relative: Do not spend a family on micro-tuning; justify a mechanism with plausible leverage or change route.
mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.after_one_additional_distinct_exact_fami: Return to L1/L0 and activate learned/student/surrogate contingency unless new causal evidence materially changes the model.

preflight_questions: What parent task does this action advance?
What causal mechanism makes it capable of material progress toward the remaining gate gap?
What result closes this experiment or mechanism?
What protected data must remain unseen?
If it fails, which parent level do we return to instead of adding variants?
